latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of To Editor Generator: instantly converts raw footage into edited videos using AI.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and describe your editing needs—cut out pauses, add transitions, export clean video, and more.
- Fully automated cloud pipeline handles all rendering and session management; no software installation required.
- Real-time feedback and streamlined workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Robust error handling for token issues, unsupported files, credit balances, and export restrictions.
- Clear, user-friendly onboarding: setup is automatic and notifies when ready to use.
